notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes: Graphical improvements and the 'easy' mode made easier.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Textures have been applied to the hoop and wires to help with depth perception.
The bug allowing players to skip to the end of a wire has been fixed.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
An extra 5% has been added to the size of the hoop on the easy setting, so now it is 15% larger.

A music selection control has been added, so you can choose between the default music, no music, or 3 different radio stations. The default music will only play when you are moving along the hoop and the radio stations will continuously play, regardless of what you are doing. The radio stations are streamed live from the internet, so you will need to be connected whilst playing, in order to hear them.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
A difficulty option has now been added where you can choose between easy and hard. The easy setting makes the hoop 10% larger and adds 5 seconds on to the time given to complete the wire.

There is now a board on the wall behind you, showing what wires you have completed and on what difficulty.

An extra achievement has been added, of which is unlocked when you have completed all the wires on hard.
